summary: OrcaRouter offers a rotating set of $0 models for established accounts. The offers page currently shows 0 vouchers and 0 credit drops, so no live voucher, student, or hackathon credit grant is promised. To access always-free models, the workspace owner must link a GitHub account with some history (or use it to sign in), or the workspace must have a paid purchase of any amount. Free models require no credit and stay free while they remain in the lineup. Use current -free model IDs or the orcarouter/free router. Current default caps are 10 requests/minute and 50/day; lifetime paid purchases of $20+ lift these to 20/minute and 800/day. Model exceptions include OrcaVerify at 5/minute and 50/day, and HY4 Preview at 50/minute and 250/day (100/minute and 4,000/day at $20+). Limits are tuned live; the lower tier also has an unpublished per-request prompt cap. Capacity is best-effort, not a production guarantee.
claim_steps: Create an account at orcarouter.ai (the offers page says an API key takes 30 seconds; no card, no sales call).
Ensure the workspace owner has a GitHub account with some history linked in profile settings or used for sign-in; a paid purchase of any amount is the alternative established-account requirement.

Check GET https://www.orcarouter.ai/api/free-package/public for current caps and free IDs. The offers page currently lists 0 vouchers and 0 credit drops. A $20 purchase is not required for established-GitHub free access.
Call orcarouter/free or a current -free catalog ID on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, subject to free-model rate and prompt-size limits.
